title: A Tool Definition Sent to the Model
description: A function signature and docstring that describe a weather tool. The agent framework sends this definition to the model so the model knows what it may call.

steps.description: This is a tool definition. The comment says it is what the agent framework sends to the model. `get_weather` takes a city string and returns a dict.
The docstring says what the tool does and names the shape of its return value: `city` as a string, `temp_c` as a float, and `condition` as a string.
The body is `...`, a placeholder. The definition describes the tool to the model; the real work happens elsewhere.

steps.question: The page says the difference between a generic model and a function-calling model is not just output quality, but what kind of reliability?
